# About This Book {.unnumbered}

The book was based on lecture notes for the course "Decision Making, Influence, and Negotiation" at the University of Southern Denmark. It was written to support a cumulative course rather than a catalogue of effects. The book is organized around the hidden processes that precede visible choices, including attention, prediction, valuation, and social influence. Each chapter includes an opening case, a figure to model the concepts, evidence interrogation, practical tools, and exercises. The text uses APA-style citations and emphasizes the importance of understanding boundary conditions for various effects.
